# SolarBidDesk
> Free public directory of US published tenders (California, Texas, New York) for solar PV, battery storage and EV chargers, with installer/EPC fit scores and official source links. Free weekly digest; Pro adds reasons, CSV and daily delta. Contact: info@solarbiddesk.com

## Key pages
- [Tender directory](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tenders/)
- [All US public bids by state and type](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/)
- [All guides](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/)
- State hubs: [California](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ca/), [Texas](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tx/), [New York](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ny/)
- RFP hubs: [Solar RFPs](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/solar-rfps/), [EV charging RFPs](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ev-charging-rfps/), [Battery storage RFPs](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/battery-storage-rfps/), [California solar RFPs](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ca/solar-rfps/), [Texas ESBD solar, EV and storage](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tx/esbd-solar-ev-storage/)
- New York: [New York energy storage RFPs (NYSERDA, NYPA, municipal BESS)](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ny/energy-storage-rfps/)
- New York: [New York solar RFPs (NYSCR, municipal and authority bids)](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ny/solar-rfps/)
- Guide: [EV charging RFPs explained: scope, NEVI/CFI funding and where to find them](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/ev-charging-rfp-guide/)
- Hub: [Solar + storage and microgrid RFPs: open public bids and how to bid](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/solar-storage-microgrid-rfps/)
- Hub: [Water and wastewater district solar RFPs: open bids and how to bid](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/water-district-solar-rfps/)
- Hub: [NYSERDA & NYPA RFPs: open solar and storage solicitations](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ny/nyserda-nypa-rfps/)
- Hub: [California EV charging RFPs: open public bids](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/ca/ev-charging-rfps/)
- Hub: [Solar carport and parking canopy RFPs for public agencies: open bids and how to bid](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/solar-carport-rfps/)
- Guide: [Battery energy storage procurement and supplier prequalification for public agencies](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/battery-storage-procurement-prequalification/)
- Guide: [Solar RFP template: what public agencies ask for](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/solar-rfp-template/) (outline download: https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/solar-rfp-template/solar-rfp-outline.md)
- Guide: [California school district solar RFPs, PPAs and Gov Code 4217](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/california-school-solar-rfp/)
- Guide: [Solar PPA RFPs: how public agencies buy solar](https://solarbiddesk.com/guides/solar-ppa-rfp/)
- Tender pages: https://solarbiddesk.com/us/tenders/<slug>/
- [Home, free digest and Pro](https://solarbiddesk.com/)

## Data (public-notice fields + scores)
- [tenders.csv](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/data/tenders.csv)
- [tenders.json](https://solarbiddesk.com/us/data/tenders.json)
- Sources: NYS Contract Reporter, Texas ESBD / SmartBuy, PlanetBids agency portals, Caltrans CCOP; SAM.gov when API keyed. Scores are screening aids, not bid advice.

## Notes
- Primary CTA is the free weekly digest; Pro is optional.
- Directory listings are free and cite the issuing agency notice.
- Sister product: PowerDealDesk (Australian NEM battery project directory).
- Last updated 2026-11-25.
